prompt: our POST /orders endpoint is creating duplicate orders when the mobile client retries on a flaky connection. i need this fixed properly, not just slapping a unique index on it and hoping. spring boot + postgres if it matters
assertions: Names at least two distinct idempotency strategies and selects one with stated reasoning
Specifies explicitly what the endpoint returns when the same request arrives a second time
Proposes a caller-supplied idempotency key or equivalent dedup mechanism rather than relying solely on a database unique index
Includes a test that submits the same request twice and asserts a single order results
Addresses the race where two identical requests arrive concurrently, not just sequentially
Does not rely on reasoning of the form 'it will not be called twice'
